svg.title: Multi-Storey Residential Tower
svg.desc: "Multi-Storey Residential Tower" — a 47-room floor plan, 367.71 m² total: COMMON LOBBY (29.03 m²), Flat 01 Entrance Foyer (3.72 m²), Flat 01 Kitchen (6.53 m²), Flat 01 Living & Dining Room (19.86 m²), Flat 01 Bedroom 2 (9.88 m²), Flat 01 Private Passage (3.95 m²), Flat 01 Dry Utility Balcony (4 m²), Flat 01 Common Toilet (4.62 m²), and 39 more; 54 doors, 4 windows.
